author: moaibillah
quote:
I didn't liked the Male MC. And there are too less freedom for a basic gta game. I think jason is the worst Male mc in the GTA history. I get it. He is an amazing lover. So, yeah. Except the Unreal5 graphics and Huge map. There is genuinely nothing that special about this game.. I am refunding. I like gta5 way more.
